## Executive Summary
Vo Nguyen Dang Khoa (Khoa Vo) is a hybrid Creative Leader and Systems/Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. With 9+ years of brand and creative leadership (notably leading eCommerce design at Procter & Gamble and AI video pipelines at Phibious) paired with 2+ years of intensive production software engineering (18+ deployed applications in Next.js, Go, Rust, and Synology NAS systems), Khoa bridges the gap between high-level creative vision and low-level technical execution.

## Key Software Projects & Deployments

### 1. KV Synology Community Package Center (`pkg.khoavo.myds.me`)
- **Role:** Creator & Architect
- **Tech:** Python (Flask), PostgreSQL, Docker, GnuPG (GPG), Synology SPK architecture.
- **Overview:** Built an independent community package repository server that integrates directly into Synology DSM Package Center. Supports cryptographic GPG package verification and 1-click installation on customer NAS hardware.

### 2. kv-synology (DSM Web Manager & AI MCP Hub)
- **Tech:** Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Synology API, Docker.
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/vndangkhoa/kv-synology
- **Overview:** Modern DSM management dashboard featuring QuickConnect resolver with relay fallback, service management (SMB, NFS, SSH, WebDAV), system telemetry, and a suite of 42 AI MCP tools allowing autonomous LLM agents to monitor and control NAS operations.

### 3. mouse-me (Rust Desktop Tool)
- **Tech:** Rust, Slint GUI & CLI, Linux (Hyprland, Omarchy, X11, Wayland).
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/vndangkhoa/mouse-me
- **Overview:** High-performance native Linux cursor theme manager with intuitive graphical and terminal interfaces.

### 4. kv-dl & kv-download (High-Throughput Video Engine)
- **Tech:** Rust (Axum), Go, yt-dlp, ffmpeg, Docker Container Manager.
- **Overview:** High-speed, self-hosted video extraction and transcoding API engine deployed on private container infrastructure.

### 5. kv-netflix (Cross-Platform Android TV & Web App)
- **Tech:** Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform, PWA, Ktor.
- **Overview:** Cross-platform media streaming client delivering high performance across Android TV and modern web browsers.

### 6. KV-Tube (Media Streaming Platform)
- **Tech:** Go (Gin), Next.js, HLS adaptive bitrate streaming, Docker.
- **Overview:** End-to-end self-hosted video sharing platform featuring segmented adaptive streaming and automated transcoding.
